description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring Mr. N. Indranathan as a member of the Porativpattu Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Porativpattu Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a resignation, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes at the local authority level, including the nomination and declaration of a new elected member, which falls under Election-related matters.
